summary: Buffalo, NY, iOS developer, co-founder of Ambur (iOS point of sale app), experience in restaurant industry, strong interest in technology and software development, critical of Apple and Google practices, libertarian views on freedom of speech and transparency, engaged in discussions about tech ethics and privacy, has worked as a waiter, recurring themes of frustration with app store policies and software quality, interest in mobile technology and user experience, advocates for better developer practices and transparency in tech.
